universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for dark colors.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for overlays/dropdowns.
Ensure high contrast for text (APCA standards).
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the frontend for Khair Baghdad Exchange. Use the defined colors and typography. Implement the 'Modern Trust' theme. Prioritize the Currency Converter functionality with a premium glassmorphism look. Use the provided image URLs. Ensure Arabic RTL support is flawless.
